# Sanuj Krishnan

> People and organization-design leader turned builder. 14+ years across Amazon/AWS, Swvl, Carrefour (Majid Al Futtaim) and Trianz. Co-founder of Work Engineering, a specification layer that makes work machine-readable so humans and AI agents can share it. Ships in code, not just slides.

Bengaluru, India. Contact: DM on LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/sanuj-krishnan/).

## Now
- Co-Founder, Work Engineering (stealth, Bengaluru): specifying AI-native orgs so work is machine-readable, verifiable and allocatable. Hiring a Founding AI Engineer.
- Writing on AI and work redesign: 'AI didn't create a productivity problem. It exposed a redesign problem.' and 'The task is the unit' (60+ source evidence review).

## Experience
- 2024-2026: Head HRBP, Trianz. Services-as-Software transformation; redeployed talent into AI platform roles (Concierto, Avrio, Agentic AI); Role Maturity Framework: 16 families, 80+ jobs, benchmarked vs Amazon/Microsoft; Co-drove AI-Native SDLC with the CTO: 8 parallel PODs using Cursor, Claude Code and Codex
- 2021-2022: Sr Manager, Human Capital, E-commerce & Technology, Carrefour MENA, Majid Al Futtaim (Dubai). Designed the org for a $1.5B e-commerce business; Built the D&I Council from zero
- 2020-2021: Director HR, Swvl. Built People from scratch across 6 countries; Restructured geography to customer-segment, pulling 3 country launches forward by 6 months
- 2012-2020: HR Business Partner (Seller Support, AWS India), Amazon / AWS. Amazon Bar Raiser; AWS Certified; People programs scaling to 4000+ hires; Drove attrition from 56% to 26%; Built Sr Leader Assimilation for 200+ L6+ leaders
- 2010-2012: MBA (HR), XLRI Jamshedpur

## Builds
- [Work Engineering](https://work-engineering.onrender.com): Spec API (FastAPI, Postgres, React). Work Units are independently accountable contracts; execution systems consume the spec.
- [Workforce Scenario Engine](https://sanoojcools-workforce-scenario-engine-app-2lrssf.streamlit.app): Monte Carlo (10k+ runs) for hiring, attrition, AI absorption and revenue per employee. Built for CHROs who think in product.
- [People Ledger](https://sanoojcools.github.io/people-ledger/app.html): Decentralized professional identity: employer-signed credentials, ZK proofs, AI job matching.
- [Architecture studies](https://github.com/sanoojcools/atlan-architecture-study): Public-signal reconstructions of Atlan and Ontora.
